abstract: We report a rare case of a nonmetastasizing beta-HCG-positive seminoma of the testis weighing 1 kg in a 59-year-old man. The stage pT1 lesion was managed successfully with orchiectomy and radiotherapy.
abstract_ja: 59歳男性の、転移を伴わない1kgのβ-hCG陽性精巣セミノーマの稀な症例を報告する。病期pT1の病変を、精巣摘除術と放射線療法により良好に治療した。
